kurals.tr: Seyyaamal Seydha Udhavikku Vaiyakamum / Vaanakamum Aatral Aridhu
kurals.m: (The gift of) heaven and earth is not an equivalent for a benefit which is conferred where none had been received

kurals.tr: Kaalaththi Naarseydha Nandri Siridheninum / Gnaalaththin Maanap Peridhu
kurals.m: A favour conferred in the time of need, though it be small (in itself), is (in value) much larger than the world

kurals.tr: Payandhookkaar Seydha Udhavi Nayandhookkin / Nanmai Katalin Peridhu
kurals.m: If we weigh the excellence of a benefit which is conferred without weighing the return, it is larger than the sea

kurals.tr: Thinaiththunai Nandri Seyinum Panaiththunaiyaak / Kolvar Payandheri Vaar
kurals.m: Though the benefit conferred be as small as a millet seed, those who know its advantage will consider it as large as a palmyra fruit

kurals.tr: Udhavi Varaiththandru Udhavi Udhavi / Seyappattaar Saalpin Varaiththu
kurals.m: The benefit itself is not the measure of the benefit; the worth of those who have received it is its measure

kurals.tr: Maravarka Maasatraar Kenmai Thuravarka / Thunpaththul Thuppaayaar Natpu
kurals.m: Forsake not the friendship of those who have been your staff in adversity Forget not be benevolence of the blameless

kurals.tr: Ezhumai Ezhupirappum Ulluvar Thangan / Vizhuman Thutaiththavar Natpu
kurals.m: (The wise) will remember throughout their seven-fold births the love of those who have wiped away their affliction

kurals.tr: Nandri Marappadhu Nandrandru Nandralladhu / Andre Marappadhu Nandru
kurals.m: It is not good to forget a benefit; it is good to forget an injury even in the very moment (in which it is inflicted)

kurals.tr: Kondranna Innaa Seyinum Avarseydha / Ondrunandru Ullak Ketum
kurals.m: Though one inflict an injury great as murder, it will perish before the thought of one benefit (formerly) conferred

kurals.tr: Ennandri Kondraarkkum Uyvuntaam Uyvillai / Seynnandri Kondra Makarku
kurals.m: He who has killed every virtue may yet escape; there is no escape for him who has killed a benefit
